Service · Recruitment Assistance

Keep your hiring pipeline full.

Recruitment specialists who source, screen and coordinate candidates for you — so your recruiters spend their time on conversations, not calendar admin.

Get StartedWhat’s included

Overview

What recruitment assistance covers — and who it’s for.

DefinitionRecruitment assistance — often called recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) support — is delegating the operational parts of hiring, such as sourcing, screening, scheduling and reporting, to an external team.

When headcount plans accelerate, recruiting teams don’t run out of judgment — they run out of hours. Sourcing gets rushed, inboxes overflow with unscreened CVs, interview loops take a week to schedule, and great candidates accept other offers while you are still chasing calendars.

Akrostech adds recruitment coordinators and sourcers who work inside your ATS, follow your scorecards and represent your employer brand. We take on the repeatable, time-consuming work — from job descriptions to onboarding paperwork — and report on every stage so you always know where the pipeline stands.

It’s designed for Heads of Talent scaling through a hiring push, HR leaders without a dedicated coordinator, and founders who are still doing their own recruiting at 11 PM.

FAQ

Recruitment Assistance, answered.

The questions decision-makers ask us before they sign. Something missing? Ask us directly.

Do you work inside our ATS?

Yes. We work in Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Bullhorn, BambooHR and most other mainstream systems, using the accounts and permissions you provide.

Can your team recruit for roles in other countries?

Yes. We source and coordinate for roles in the USA, UK, Europe, Australia and the Middle East, following your local process and compliance requirements.

Who makes the hiring decision?

You always do. We source, screen and coordinate against your criteria; your recruiters and hiring managers interview and decide.

How do you protect candidate data?

Candidate data stays inside your systems. Our team works under NDA with role-based access, and we follow GDPR-aware handling for every candidate record.

Do you charge per hire?

No. We charge a transparent monthly fee per dedicated specialist, so there is no incentive to push volume over quality.
